title: Factori-0 Rebuild
description: Factory-0 Rebuild brings Factorio-style automation. Use Scanners to map ore density and coal-fired Burner Drills for efficient, heavy-duty resource extraction independent of the power grid.
body:
**​Efficiency is not a choice, it’s a requirement.**
Inspired by the core mechanics of **Factorio**, this mod introduces a system for resource gathering. Move away from manual mining and establish a high-throughput industrial outpost.

​1. **Geological Scanner (The Intelligence)**
​In a professional production line, guessing is a waste of resources. The Scanner is your primary tool for site analysis.
​Function: Scans the underlying chunks to detect ore density and resource types.
​Operational Logic: It provides the data necessary to optimize drill placement, ensuring you never deploy heavy machinery on barren ground.
​Strategic Advantage: Maximizes your Return on Investment (ROI) by identifying the richest veins before consumption begins.

![Scanner.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0ac83004f67ccf8fc8d9a7eba6c88be7fab1b19_0.webp)

​2. Burner Drill (The Steam Age)
​The entry-point for automated extraction. Reliable, heavy-duty, and completely autonomous from the power grid.
​Power Source: Solid combustion (Coal, Block of Coal).
​Performance: Ideal for early-game expansion and remote outposts where power lines haven't reached yet.
​Limitation: Requires manual refueling or basic hopper automation; lower cycle speed compared to electric alternatives.

![Drill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d72378e8f954a00982bed89d61b2e260f68c5832_0.webp)


Thanks for playing, Juki097
